messages:
carla: Deploy window open — kicking off shoulder-roll for feature flag `edge-cohort-softslice`. Deploy bot starting canary on svc-edge (rev v3.7.2). Ramp plan initially 5% -> 25% over 20m. Release notes: https://redwood/notes/edge-cohort-softslice :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary 1/6 started on svc-edge (rev v3.7.2). Traffic=5%. Scheduled increments at +5m and +10m. To pause: `@deploy-bot pause-ramp edge-cohort-softslice`. To disable flag: `@deploy-bot disable-flag edge-cohort-softslice`.

mike: Quick q — can we pin traffic to the older model if things go sideways? we hit drift last time around 12% traffic.

carla: Yes. Fallback policy: prefer quick flag disable (fast) then pin to v3.7.1 as secondary. Rollback triggers: latency dev >20ms p50 or error rate >0.5% sustained for 2 minutes. Also OOM/mem pressure >70% on gpu-pool -> immediate drain.

sre-oncall: I'll be watching dashboards. If p95 spikes or error% climbs I'll call for disable. Set my pager to urgent for this thread.

analytics-bot: Telemetry hook enabled. Baseline p50=72ms p95=210ms. Will post deltas every 5m.

lana: Noting embedding token usage is up ~3% on canary samples (longer ctx). Recommend we slow the ramp: 5% -> 15% @ +10m -> 30% @ +20m instead of jumping to 25% at +5m. Less noisy for cost/latency signals.

carla: Good catch. Updating ramp schedule to 5% -> 15% (+10m) -> 30% (+20m). Add gating: if mem pressure >70% or any OOMs, pause and pin.

mike: For clarity on rollback steps: do we first flip flag off or pin routing? which gets precedence in runbook?

carla: Order of ops in runbook: 1) `@deploy-bot disable-flag edge-cohort-softslice` (fastest, immediate traffic stop), 2) if that doesn't stabilize, `route pin svc-edge -> v3.7.1` via infra tooling. We'll document exact commands in release notes.

deploy-bot: FYI: `@deploy-bot disable-flag edge-cohort-softslice` propagates in ~4s. `@deploy-bot pause-ramp edge-cohort-softslice` will hold current percentage and set canary to HELD state. Use correct syntax to avoid accidental disables.

sre-oncall: :thumbsup: My explicit thresholds: p95 > 400ms or error rate >1% sustained for 3 consecutive minutes -> disable flag. I'll call before pinning.

prodeng: Added short blurb to release notes and Slack release thread: "Edge cohort softslice: scoring accuracy improvements, monitor latency and cost; rollback path: disable flag then pin to v3.7.1. Contacts: @sre-oncall, @carla."

carla: Thanks — starting slow ramp now (5% -> 15%). Leaving ops in the loop.

analytics-bot: Telemetry (5m): p50=75ms (+3ms), p95=215ms (+5ms), errors=0.12% -> healthy so far. Next check in +5m.

mike: If we need to halt progression quickly we do `@deploy-bot pause-ramp edge-cohort-softslice`?

deploy-bot: Correct. Command accepted: `@deploy-bot pause-ramp edge-cohort-softslice`. That will mark canary HELD and stop any scheduled increases.

sre-oncall: Note — when paused, manual resume required. Also we'll annotate the canary with the reason.

carla: Perfect. Ops watches in place. If no alerts by +30m we proceed to 30%.
